```{r setup}
library(piptb)
gls <- create_globals(Sys.getenv("PIP_root_dir"))

# get countries in Table maker
inv <- fst::read_fst(paste0(gls$CACHE_SVY_TB_DIR, "_crr_inventory/crr_inventory.fst"),
                     as.data.table = TRUE)

countries_tb <-
  inv[,
      country_code := data.table::tstrsplit(cache_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)
  ][,unique(country_code)]


tb_create_arrow_poss <- purrr::possibly(tb_create_arrow, 
                                        otherwise = NULL)

lr <- purrr::map(countries_tb, 
          tb_create_arrow_poss)

names(lr) <- countries_tb

pushover("Done with tb_create_arrow")


```
